title: Chrome Product
line: Graphite stage, silver type, an ice-blue glint: the premium product reveal.
line_zh: 石墨色舞台，银色文字，冰蓝光芒：高端产品揭晓。
prompt: Chrome product style: graphite stage, silver-white type with an ice-blue accent, a brushed-metal sheen and one star glint, tracking that collapses, zoom-through and luma-wipe transitions, a cinematic drone with a light sweep and a metallic hit.
prompt_zh: 铬金属产品风格：石墨色舞台，银白文字配冰蓝点缀，拉丝金属光泽与一道星芒，字距收拢字效，穿越缩放与亮度擦除转场，电影感低鸣配乐，配光扫声与金属重击。
essence: Restraint and sheen: a dark stage, cool light and metal, and a reveal that lands like a premium product launch. One glint, never a light show.

not.difference: Neon Night is saturated, warm-hot and busy with bokeh; Chrome Product is cool, metallic and sparse.
Swiss Grid is flat black on white; Chrome Product is light on dark with sheen.

palette.logic: a graphite stage, silver-white ink, ONE ice-blue for the key word and the button

camera.expresses: a slow push onto the product

sound.foley: a light sweep, metal latches and a metallic hit

signature_features.text: silver-white ink on graphite at 14:1, ice-blue at 11:1 (contrast.py)
luma wipes, zoom-throughs and dips only
a cinematic drone bed with hardware sounds
upper-case letters that rise, the name tracking in tight
one glint per film, on the reveal side of the frame

demo.lint: mp lint 96.3/100, 51 PASS, 5 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A
demo.made_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) through mp plan --style, mp new, mp render (HyperFrames, CRF 18) and mp lint, on 21 Oct 2026; 1 to 4 agent re-renders per style (fixes found by mp lint and the contact sheets), 0 human rounds; the same placeholder copy in every style

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
